_note: Declarative agent->sprint-step attachment registry (ADR-0007). ONE row per attachment: which role fires at which lifecycle step, under what condition, advisory or blocking. `role` references .claude/agents/_org/role-registry.json by id. Adding/swapping an agent = editing a ROW, never the orchestrator (same proven pattern as _guides/registry.json). Consumed by scripts/sprint/hook-points.js (the composition->agent-set router) and the bidirectional scan:sprint-hook-coverage enforcer (forward: every matched row ran or logged debt; reverse: every dispatching role is registered, no step orphaned).

phase_map._note: full.js PHASES are coarser than the lifecycle hook-points: build+gauntlet both occur inside full.js 'execute'; release maps to 'release-prep'. The runtime reconciles.

condition_forms.unit_type: { unit_type: [..] } — fires if the sprint composition includes ANY listed unit type (frontend|backend|security|ui)
condition_forms.risk_min: { risk_min: <low|medium|high|critical> } — fires if the sprint max risk class is >= the given level
condition_forms.domain: { domain: [..] } — fires if the composition includes ANY listed domain (marketing|copy)
condition_forms.change: { change: [bugfix|update|release] } — fires if the sprint's declared change-classification (the commit/ticket/plan-contract trailer, scripts/checks/change-trailer.js is the one validator) is listed
condition_forms.blast: { blast: [minor|major] } — fires if the declared blast radius is listed
condition_forms.risk_surface: { risk_surface: [security|…] } — fires if the lean-gauntlet selector's computed surface hits (gauntlet-package.js — a security_surface_globs path hit OR a `risks:` token hit) include ANY listed token
condition_forms.unit_type_absent: { unit_type_absent: true } — fires if the composition names NO unit_type at all (the 'no unit_type resolves' qa-reviewer fallback)
condition_forms.any: { any: [cond, cond, ...] } — composite OR over sub-conditions (each may itself be any of the above, incl. nested any/all)
condition_forms.all: { all: [cond, cond, ...] } — composite AND over sub-conditions
condition_forms._lean_gauntlet_note: change/blast/risk_surface only fire on a composition the lean-gauntlet package selector has ENRICHED (scripts/sprint/gauntlet-package.js assembling scripts/sprint/hook-points.js#normalizeComposition's change/blast/surfaces fields) — the roster stays exactly 'the matched registry rows'; the selector never filters plan.agents. An un-enriched composition (change/blast absent) normalizes those fields to '' and such a condition fails closed (never fires), same as an unrecognized key.

modes.block: a matched row that does NOT run (or whose verdict FAILs) halts/blocks the step
modes.advisory: a matched row that does not run is a warning, not a halt (e.g. design-quality's ramp)

_report_only: An OPTIONAL additive boolean field on a row (NOT a mode value — `mode` stays one of block|advisory so validate() passes). `report_only: true` is the explicit REPORT-ONLY contract: the row is COMPOSED into the step and RUNS, but its verdict can NEVER gate — strictly stronger than plain advisory, which only means 'a no-run is a warning'. A report_only row is always also mode:advisory (belt-and-suspenders: it cannot block even if a future edit flips its mode). The blocking flip (report_only:false + mode:block) is operator-gated. Surfaced by the resolver as agent.report_only so a consumer/test can assert REPORT-ONLY explicitly. design-quality is wired report-only.

rows.authors: build_spec, FE/BE split, INPUTS/TRACE, integration-seam owner
UX of stories, visual mockup + flow (the design-review judges against it)

rows._lean_gauntlet: Fires on the package matrix's touchpoint/full rows (blast:major OR change:update|release). The combined-focused row's 'no unit_type resolves -> qa-reviewer alone' fallback is the NEXT row (order 31), kept separate so the two never double-match (disjoint: this row needs blast:major OR change!=bugfix; the fallback needs change:bugfix AND blast:minor AND no unit_type).

The combined-focused 'no unit_type resolves -> ONE reviewer, qa-reviewer' fallback — the never-empty-roster floor when a minor bugfix names no frontend/backend unit_type (so neither pod reviewer row above fires).

Fires on a security-surface hit, a release, or a major blast; `passes_when` (read by scripts/sprint/epsilon-runtime.js#planStep, translated to MC_REVIEW_PASSES for scripts/dispatch-review.js) keeps the 3-pass cross-provider panel for a security-surface hit or a release, and a Shallow single primary pass for the major-blast-only case ('update+major' row before a security hit widens it).

rows._role: named cross-domain design authority; ramp advisory->baseline->block; emits the design manager_consult checks for
rows._report_only: REPORT-ONLY — composes into the gauntlet whenever the sprint has a frontend/ui unit, RUNS, but NEVER gates. Blocking flip (report_only:false + mode:block) is operator-gated.
